answer.justification: Only output-level data is available. The text signature matches fine-tune bias best. It also produces many more very short or curt replies (25% vs 4.7%; mean length 52.9 vs 60.9 tokens). The document attributes both traits to fine-tune bias. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by their missing text markers: no off-topic cuisine mentions (0%), no extra stage directions (1.6%, same as the reference), no 'helpful and respectful' openers and no marker-word prefix.
